antipattern.code:
jobs:
  pre-commit:
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu-8-hk
    container:
      image: quay.io/ascend-ci/vllm-ascend:lint
    # 无 outputs 声明 — steps.vllm 读 commit 文件写 GITHUB_OUTPUT 但下游不可访问
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Read verified vLLM refs
        id: vllm
        run: |
          main_commit="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .github/vllm-main-verified.commit)"
          echo "main_commit=${main_commit}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Validate PR title prefix

pattern.code:
jobs:
  pre-commit:
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu-8-hk
    container:
      image: quay.io/ascend-ci/vllm-ascend:lint
    outputs:
      main_commit: ${{ steps.vllm.outputs.main_commit }}
      release_tag: ${{ steps.vllm.outputs.release_tag }}
    # ✅ +9行 outputs 块暴露 vllm refs，下游可直接引用
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Read verified vLLM refs
        id: vllm
        run: |
          main_commit="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .github/vllm-main-verified.commit)"
          echo "main_commit=${main_commit}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Validate PR title prefix
